title: Sandbox service-registry fragment (<repo>/.sandbox/services.yaml)
description: A repo's slice of the service registry. `sandbox registry sync` (run by `sandbox setup`) merges every fragment under paths.repos_root into ~/.sandbox/services.yaml. `{{home}}`, `{{repos_root}}` and `{{workspaces_root}}` expand in any string at merge time. Mirrors the checks in packages/sandbox-core/registry_sync.ts.

services.description: Application services this repo owns. Names must be unique across all repos.

setup_services.description: One-shot install/build containers that services gate on via `setup_service`.

infrastructure.description: Cluster datastores port-forwarded into the docker world by the k8s-forwards container. Never run locally.

^x-.description: Holds YAML anchors; dropped from the generated registry.

environment.description: Compose `environment:`. Beats every env_file (including the service's secrets file), so never put `${SECRET}` here; declare it in `secrets:` instead.

volumes.description: Extra compose volume specs (`src:dst[:ro]`). Bare names are per-feature named volumes.

healthEndpoint.description: HTTP path (e.g. /health), `redis` or `postgres` for a protocol probe, or "" for TCP-only.

repo.description: Derived from the checkout's directory name. If set, it must equal that name.

path.description: Service directory within the repo; `.` for the whole repo. Drives the repo's path_mappings.

archetype.description: Key in the registry's `archetypes:` (defaults: node-web, node-service, node-tool, mcp-client). Selects standards and MCP servers.

standards.description: Legacy: standards keys used only when `archetype` is unset.

test.description: Test command, run from the repo root.

internal_port.description: Port the process listens on in-container (Helm containerPort).

port_offset.description: Slot-relative host port. Must be unique across ALL repos.

dockerfile.description: Relative to `path`; only used when no image template applies. Default Dockerfile.

command.description: Run via `sh -c` from /app (the repo root), not from `path`.

setup_service.description: Key in `setup_services:` this service waits on (service_completed_successfully).

node_modules_volume.description: Per-feature named volume mounted over node_modules.

secrets.description: Keys `sandbox up` requires in ~/.sandbox/secrets.env, as `<SERVICE>__KEY` or plain `KEY`; delivered as plain `KEY` via the service's own `<workspace>/.env.<service>` env_file.

depends_on.description: Services that must be healthy before this one starts.

extra_services.description: Sidecar containers rendered next to this service.

feature_router.description: Opts into Caddy ingress at <service>.<local_domain>. `{}` for local-only.

remote_upstream.description: host:port Caddy dials for the remote route (a k8s-forwards alias, not cluster DNS). Opts into a remote route.

k8s_port_name.description: Named Service port; required by intercept.

k8s_pod_prefix.description: Pod name prefix the port-forward selects.

k8s_forward_port.description: Host listen port of the k8s-forwards tunnel. Unique across ALL repos.

k8s_forward_name.description: Network alias for the tunnel when it differs from the service name.

repo.description: Derived from the checkout's directory name.

image.description: Must match the image of the services that use its node_modules.

k8s_forward_port.description: Host listen port. Unique across ALL repos.
